sourceEvidence.title: Supply Chain Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, operations, or related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
* 3 years of progressively responsible experience in supply chain or materials management, including purchasing, material planning, inventory control and warehouse operations. Experience in regulated manufacturing environment preferred.
* CTBS/AATB certification preferred
